Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Disabled veterans receive a rating-scaled residence-homestead exemption, and a 100% service-connected or individually unemployable veteran receives a total homestead property-tax exemption, with surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Killeen is an affordable Central Texas city built around Fort Cavazos (formerly Fort Hood), one of the largest U.S. Army posts. It offers in-city VA outpatient care, Texas's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay, Walmart access, and a large veteran and active-duty community. Tradeoffs include moderate crime, hot and humid summers, no local Costco, and a diverse city that leans more Democratic than surrounding Bell County.
